title: CORE-7347 · [RF] 404 page missing styled content, needs header/footer confirmed
body:
Linear: https://linear.app/bsq-group/issue/CORE-7347/rf-404-page-missing-styled-content-needs-headerfooter-confirmed

(Reference only — the ticket is the source of truth; fetch the live description at implement time.)

Imported by Planning 2026-09-04 (board↔Linear sync, second pass — this ticket was newly assigned at Todo and had no board row).
acceptanceCriteria: The clone's 404 page body renders Live's styled 404 content between header and footer: "Error 404" heading, "Page not available" subheading, the explanatory paragraph ("Sorry! It looks like this page is no longer available..."), a "Go back to homepage." link with a left-chevron icon pointing to "/", and the three-staff illustration image.
Header and footer render correctly on the 404 page with no regression (already confirmed present/matching per the ticket — verify still true after the content fix).
Visually matches Live's 404 page layout (two-column content+illustration on desktop, stacked on mobile) at all 4 breakpoints: 360 / 768 / 1024 / 1800.
Navigating to a non-existent URL returns HTTP 404 status (not 200) while rendering the styled content.
No new console errors introduced (e.g. next/image localPatterns violations) on the 404 page.

statusHistory.note: restart from scratch: lane SIGTERM-killed (exit 143) by sibling lane's unscoped pkill; branch work committed+pushed; re-dispatch
